sources.title: OpenAI and NVIDIA announce strategic partnership to deploy 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems

event.title: OpenAI and NVIDIA systems partnership (letter of intent)
event.summary: OpenAI and NVIDIA announced a letter of intent to deploy at least 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems for OpenAI. NVIDIA said it intends to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI as the systems are deployed.

amounts.label: NVIDIA intended investment
amounts.condition: Invested progressively as each gigawatt is deployed; letter of intent, final details still to be agreed
amounts.quote: To support the partnership, NVIDIA intends to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI progressively as each gigawatt is deployed.

quantities.label: NVIDIA systems to deploy
quantities.quote: Strategic partnership enables OpenAI to build and deploy at least 10 gigawatts of AI datacenters with NVIDIA systems representing millions of GPUs for OpenAI's next-generation AI infrastructure.

facts.label: Letter of intent
facts.text: The two companies announced a letter of intent, not a final agreement.
facts.quote: San Francisco and Santa Clara—September 22, 2025—NVIDIA and OpenAI today announced a letter of intent for a landmark strategic partnership to deploy at least 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems for OpenAI's next-generation AI infrastructure to train and run its next generation of models on the path to deploying superintelligence.

facts.label: First deployment
facts.text: The first gigawatt is planned for the second half of 2026 on NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform.
facts.quote: The first gigawatt of NVIDIA systems will be deployed in the second half of 2026 on NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform.

facts.label: Next step
facts.text: NVIDIA and OpenAI said they would finalize the details in the following weeks.
facts.quote: NVIDIA and OpenAI look forward to finalizing the details of this new phase of strategic partnership in the coming weeks.

facts.label: Preferred partner
facts.text: OpenAI will work with NVIDIA as a preferred strategic compute and networking partner.
facts.quote: OpenAI will work with NVIDIA as a preferred strategic compute and networking partner for its AI factory growth plans.
